verdict: Yes. Sudathi from Surat pitched sarees and kurtas on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal from three sharks. Surat is one of India's biggest textile hubs, and a brand with good designs and live selling can grow fast.
angle: Everyday and festive sarees and kurtas sell year-round, with peaks during weddings and festivals. Surat gives easy access to fabrics and production. Instagram live selling and WhatsApp communities are strong channels.
